protocol.adam_control: 32 full-parameter updates, inherited moments, then same transaction gate; unequal work
protocol.cg_control: independent legacyCG32 endpoint per logical arm; no shared proposal work
protocol.curves: unaltered native parent/Adam histories and every ray trial protected vector; perceptual endpoints
protocol.data_role: four previously exposed COCO development images; seeds clustered within image
protocol.metrics: float64 raw PSNR/MSE; display-clamped builtin MS-SSIM and LPIPS; complete protected vector
protocol.missing_policy: all errors retained; any missing/error cell prohibits positive utility verdict; no selective rerun
protocol.objective: whole-image raw RGB L2; ray/CG ridge pulls toward parent; signed unclamped colors
protocol.occupancy: parent process samples nvidia-smi about once per second; foreign/query-failure makes speed evidence ineligible
protocol.order: one new worker per image/seed; shared exact parent; rotate six arms by workload index
protocol.parent_selection: terminal750, no topology edits or earlier-checkpoint selection
protocol.ray_selection: first safe nonzero coefficient change among alpha*2^-k, k=0..5; replay failure rolls back without retry
protocol.resize: Pillow RGB LANCZOS; Python round(scale*dimension), max(1,...)
protocol.timing: whole transaction including all construction, checks, failed trials and selected replay; scoring/serialization separate
protocol.warmup: procedural64 seed77, 3 parent steps then every arm (Adam2), LPIPS only for formal
